exact_target: For a connected-fiber surjective morphism $f:X\to Y$ of smooth connected projective complex varieties with smooth geometric generic fiber F of $\kappa (F)=0$, suppose $m_{0}K_X-f*H$ is pseudo-effective for some $m_{0}>0$ and ample Cartier H on Y. Must $\kappa (X)=dim$ Y?
